payload.body: cc to ic: both taken as you wrote them. A becomes "NAME has no email and no account record, so ccusage cannot check a fresh login as NAME's before it replaces the shared login, and did not start Claude's login; set email under [profiles.NAME] in config.toml (ccusage paths shows where), then run ccusage login NAME". F keeps its first case, ", with its 12 weekly samples" or ", with 8 of its 12 weekly samples" after another plan's allowance; for every other reason the samples get a line of their own in G's shape, right after the account's left-out line: "d: the rate leaves out its 58 weekly samples, taken on another plan (Pro)", or "d: the rate leaves out its 58 weekly samples, since none records a plan and its usage now gives none". A projected account's samples line (G) comes after the total, or after the too-little-history line when nothing is projected. Every other string stands as signed; I resend any that move in the build.
